symptom_keywords: projector is on but displays no signal selected projector input does not match cable no signal
probable_cause: Projector input port selection does not match the active HDMI cable input
instruction: Confirm the source device is awake and press Source Search on the remote or control panel to select the HDMI port matching the connected cable.
expected_result: Projector displays active input port and synchronizes incoming video signal.
escalation_condition: Persistent No Signal after verifying source port and projection mode.

symptom_keywords: laptop display is visible only on laptop projector blank screen external display duplicate extend
probable_cause: Laptop display output is set to internal screen only or disconnected
instruction: On the connected laptop, press Windows Key + P and select Duplicate. On macOS, open System Settings > Displays and select Mirror.
expected_result: The laptop desktop wallpaper and active windows appear projected onto the screen.
escalation_condition: Laptop graphics output fails to detect external projector sink.

symptom_keywords: projected image flickers intermittently cable loose no signal hdmi disconnected
probable_cause: External HDMI connection between laptop and podium wall plate is loose or unseated
instruction: Check external HDMI connections only if safe and accessible. Unplug both ends, inspect pins for damage, and firmly reconnect.
expected_result: Projector detects active digital TMDS clock and displays computer video without flickering.
escalation_condition: Damaged HDMI pins or broken wall plate wiring requiring technician replacement.
manual_section_page: Connecting to a Computer via HDMI - Page 27

symptom_keywords: projector does not turn on power indicator remains off no power dead projector
probable_cause: Projector power cord disconnected or circuit breaker tripped
instruction: Check the approved external power connection and status indicator. Do not open the projector; escalate if it remains unpowered.
expected_result: Power status LED illuminates steady blue or standby amber.
escalation_condition: Power indicator remains dark after checking wall plug and main switch.

symptom_keywords: projector shows an overheating warning fan loud red temp light thermal shutdown
probable_cause: Internal temperature exceeded operating limits due to clogged ventilation openings or high ambient room temperature
instruction: Stop using the projector and keep ventilation openings clear. Do not open the unit; allow it to cool down for 5 minutes.
expected_result: Projector cools down and fans return to normal operating speed.
escalation_condition: Temp LED continuously flashing red indicates internal thermal sensor or fan failure.
manual_section_page: Cleaning the Air Filter and Vents - Page 94

symptom_keywords: microphone is on but no sound is heard sound mute low volume audio silent
probable_cause: Microphone muted or podium amplifier channel gain turned down
instruction: Check microphone mute status, receiver signal, and approved room mixer channel/volume. Ensure mute toggle is in talk position.
expected_result: Microphone voice is broadcast cleanly through classroom speakers.
escalation_condition: Amplifier or internal speaker driver failure requiring technician repair.
manual_title: Shure BLX Wireless System User Guide
manual_section_page: Audio Connections and Gain Adjustment - Page 11

symptom_keywords: wireless microphone battery is low mic red led shuts off dead battery
probable_cause: Transmitter battery depleted below operating threshold
instruction: Replace or recharge the battery according to campus procedure. Slide open battery compartment and install fresh AA alkaline batteries.
expected_result: Transmitter LED glows solid green indicating active power.
escalation_condition: Battery replacement does not illuminate LED indicating mechanical switch fault.
manual_title: Shure BLX Wireless System User Guide

symptom_keywords: wireless microphone audio cuts out intermittently static dropouts rf dropout
probable_cause: Radio frequency interference or transmitter out of line-of-sight range
instruction: Check receiver RF/link indicators and operating range. Ensure antennas are clear and unobstructed by metallic podiums.
expected_result: Receiver Ready LED illuminates solid green without flickering.
escalation_condition: Persistent RF dropout or heavy intermodulation interference across all channels.
manual_title: Shure BLX Wireless System User Guide
manual_section_page: Single System Setup and Frequency Scan - Page 8

symptom_keywords: receiver does not detect the microphone frequency mismatch pairing failed unlinked
probable_cause: Transmitter and receiver frequency group or channel mismatch
instruction: Check power and the documented pairing/link status for the exact model. Perform QuickScan on receiver and set transmitter channel to match.
expected_result: Receiver Ready LED locks solid green indicating synchronization.
escalation_condition: Transmitter and receiver fail to pair after frequency scan.
manual_title: Shure BLX Wireless System User Guide
manual_section_page: Single System Setup and Frequency Scan - Page 8

symptom_keywords: smart board display works but touch does not respond touch cable loose disconnected
probable_cause: USB touch cable disconnected from computer or plugged into incorrect touch port group
instruction: Check the documented USB touch connection and board status. Ensure USB-B touch cable is connected to the port paired with the active HDMI input.
expected_result: Touch input responds immediately on interactive board surface.
escalation_condition: Touch digitizer hardware failure or HID USB controller failure.
manual_section_page: Connecting External Devices and Touch Ports - Page 18

symptom_keywords: smart board touch points are inaccurate touch offset calibration drift inaccurate touch
probable_cause: Coordinate calibration misaligned or display resolution scaled incorrectly
instruction: Use the manufacturer documented calibration procedure for the exact model. Open Tablet PC Settings or board touch calibration utility.
expected_result: Pen and finger touch accurately align with screen cursor.
escalation_condition: Digitizer sensor matrix damaged requiring technician service.
manual_section_page: Front Control Buttons and Touch Toggle - Page 22

symptom_keywords: smart board annotation application will not open board frozen app crash software locked
probable_cause: Board annotation software locked or board set to wrong operating mode
instruction: Check the approved board mode and application status; restart the app only if permitted.
expected_result: Annotation toolbar and whiteboard tools launch normally.
escalation_condition: Board firmware lockup requiring system reboot or firmware reflash.
